dialogues.speaker: Macadell
dialogues.text: *sigh* There's no way I'm modifying the prototype with how things are now...

choices.text: About the Portable Mini Pneumousia Storage Device...

response.speaker: Macadell
response.text: This Portable Mini Pneumousia Storage Device prototype is the result of the research of my project team.

response.speaker: Macadell
response.text: Our team's research went swimmingly at first, and everything was normal... But who could have guessed that an explosion would suddenly rock the Fontaine Research Institute?

response.speaker: Macadell
response.text: Many researchers from our group were caught in the blast, and the majority of our research materials were a complete loss...

response.speaker: Macadell
response.text: Now, apart from me, there's basically nobody else who can continue the work and push the research forward.

response.speaker: Macadell
response.text: To save our project, I've got to prove the value of this prototype as soon as I can.

response.speaker: Macadell
response.text: But... who knew something like this would happen? Just where is the issue...

response.speaker: Macadell
response.text: Because this Portable Mini Pneumousia Storage Device prototype is having a few minor issues...

response.speaker: Macadell
response.text: It's external power output fluctuates when connected to the Pressurized Impactor.

response.speaker: Macadell
response.text: This kind of unstable energy output is even destabilizing the Pressurized Impactor's output strength.

response.speaker: Macadell
response.text: When the output is high, this machine can easily crush rocks. But when output is low, even drilling a hole in mud is challenging.

response.speaker: Macadell
response.text: Ugh... Although, I must stress that even though this machine is having output stability issues...

response.speaker: Macadell
response.text: It is still extremely safe. Even if you don't turn it on during the energy output peak, at most the Impactor will also have low output.

response.speaker: Macadell
response.text: There is absolutely no chance of it exploding, catching fire, leaking energy, the casing melting, or anything else of the sort... so please don't worry.

response.speaker: Macadell
response.text: See you later. Please don't forget to help me test the device! Thanks!
